content: IMPORTANT: github.com/mvrdevelopment/tools does NOT contain a GDTF/MVR parsing library or an MVRxchange protocol client. It contains: a Wireshark dissector for the MVR-xchange TCP protocol (diagnostic tool only), GDTF/MVR XSD schemas + Schematron validation rules, and GDTF-Share public API docs. The actual reusable parsing libraries are separate open-source projects under the open-stage GitHub org: python-gdtf (pygdtf) and python-mvr (pymvr), both pure Python, pip-installable. The only known full open-source Python implementation of the MVR-xchange network protocol itself lives inside the BlenderDMX Blender addon (open-stage/blender-dmx), not as a standalone library.
